Hi,
Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to [LOCATION] and complete the delivery.
This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.
I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and we can put this all behind us.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH
CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = ME-01
FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING
*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********
Two bank guards were reported missing last week. A few hours ago, their bodies turned up in a trash heap in Magnus with their biometrics stolen. Thankfully, a nearby dumpling cart had a security camera that captured the corpses being dropped. Facial recognition was able to ID one Kass Dent, romantic partner to Maltrox Arlington and parent of Les Arlington. Using the vid to construct a timeline, we have provided the coordinates of where Kass is currently believed to be hiding.
Kass is suspected of a long list of murders, with these two only being the most recent. We recommend only bringing highly skilled wingman to try and keep the casualty count at a minimum.
You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.
Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.
This contract is non-negotiable.
This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.
13o9de3.description_zh:
埃克哈特安保有限公司
合约 & 差事

合约类型：集体逮捕令
合约状态：独立
授权代码 = [CONTRACTOR]

需要立即处理

*********
__背景信息__
臭名昭著的阿灵顿帮居然试图从一个修船厂中盗窃一艘伊德里斯级护卫舰，作为回应，他们每个人都在这一份集体逮捕令中。这次盗窃被阻止了，那群渣滓落荒而逃，分散躲进了黑暗中。皆是无胆鼠辈，大难临头各自飞。埃克哈特安保收到了一份对阿灵顿帮高级成员的即时赏金逮捕令。成员包括：马尔特克斯·阿灵顿，卡斯·登特，尼克斯·坎特威尔，萨姆“爱哭鬼”阿灵顿，奥斯陆·阿灵顿和莱斯·阿灵顿。
*********

上礼拜，有两名银行守卫失踪。几小时前，有人在马格努斯的一个垃圾堆里发现了他们的尸体。尸体完整，但是他们的生物特征证件被窃取了。幸运的是，附近的饺子车上有一个摄像头记录下了抛尸的全过程。经过面部识别调查后，我们锁定了抛尸者：卡斯·登特。此人与阿灵顿帮首领马尔特克斯·阿灵顿的关系十分暧昧，且是莱斯·阿灵顿的母亲。我们根据视频重建了目标抛尸的时间轴。根据时间轴，我们推测出了卡斯当前隐藏的坐标。

 不止此次抛尸，卡斯还涉嫌参与一长串的谋杀案件，其中有两件是最近发生的我们建议你携带一名或多名训练有素的助手与目标交锋以避免可能的伤亡。

你被授权使用任何必要的火力，枪炮刀剑都无所谓，把他干掉。

报酬将于合约成功完成后发放。

该合约不可转让。

此消息中可能包含机密、专有、特许保密的和/或私人信息，该等资料仅供上述指定的个人或实体使用。

You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.
Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at [LOCATION]. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.
You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.
When you’re done, take the stuff to [DESTINATION] and I’ll sort you out with a reward.
-Twitch

你有没有过那种感觉——问别人问题时，明明觉得他在撒谎，可你还是选择信他一回？对，我现在就处在这种状况。

我雇了两个自称“专家”的运输工，帮我运点货，结果他们半路出事，直接把我的货扔在了 [LOCATION]。不用说，我已经下了追杀令，但现在我需要你去把那批货给捞回来。追踪器显示货还在船上，你只需要带个重型牵引光束和你自己的船，直接去拖走就行。

可能会有几个捡破烂的在那边晃荡，不过我觉得你应付起来应该不费劲。

搞定之后，把货送到 [DESTINATION]，报酬少不了你的。

- 刺痛

1bd2ioo.description_en:
Hi,
Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.
If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.
Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.
Just do the job and get home safe, okay?
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
1bd2ioo.description_zh:
嗨，

又是新的一天，又有一个信标。在 [LOCATION] 那边有一艘 [SHIP] 希望能补充 [FUELTYPE]。客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我也不骗你：那地方一旦被困住可不好受，要是被偷袭就更糟糕了。我们在那儿已经损失了不少人 - 哪怕是运气好活下来的，回家时也缺胳膊少腿的。

如果你决定接这活儿，帮我个忙，时刻提高警惕。如果你有个朋友正好有空，不妨叫上他搭把手做点支援。

也许是我多虑了，但这并不意味着他们不会找你麻烦，正如德洛特妈妈常说的那样。
其实她从来没说过这话 - 不过我敢打赌，如果她靠这个谋生，她肯定这么说。

把活儿干完，平安回家，好吗？

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

1d26ld6.description_en:
Any interest in taking out a [TARGET] for us?
Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by [LOCATION] soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.
They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.
You pull this off and I'll toss 3 Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.
- Stows
1d26ld6.description_zh:
有兴趣帮我们解决掉 [AMBUSHTARGET] 吗？

应该不会太麻烦。我们已经踩好点了，发现他们很快就会经过 [LOCATION]。你只需要藏在附近的辐射云里，就能打他们个措手不及。

目标可能是单枪匹马或带着几个帮手，都是单座战机但空战能力不俗。等交火开始后，我们会派些人手过去支援。

你要是能把这事儿办成了，我会给主承包商 [SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证 作为报酬。

- 斯托斯

1gk4ho7.description_en:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: [SYSTEM]
TERMS*:
Due to changes in our sourcing pipeline, Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to purchase a variety of refined materials from independent miners operating in the area. While selling at a trade hub may net you a more competitive price than fulfilling our order, many miners find that strengthening their ties to Shubin to be a wise long-term investment for their career.
[LOCATION] For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal. While you're there, feel free to read the first part Mining Fundamentals #1: Basic Overview if you want a refresher on how to get the materials.
Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a [MULTITOOL].
Please note that in an effort to expedite future use of these materials, they must be refined before delivery. This can be done at any refinery, the locations of which can be found in your Starmap.
Once you’re ready to sell us the required refined materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.
1gk4ho7.description_zh:
发布：采购订单
地点：[SYSTEM] 

条款*：
由于我们的采购渠道发生变化，舒宾星际目前正在寻求从该地区独立矿工处购买各种精炼材料。虽然在贸易中心出售可能获得比完成我们的订单获得更具竞争力的价格，但许多矿工发现，加强与舒宾的关系是职业生涯中明智的长期投资。

[HINT_LOCATION] 要获取这些矿物的详细产地列表，请查阅你的 mobiGlas 日志中的《采矿基础 #2：去哪里采矿》。如果你需要复习如何获取这些材料，也可以顺便阅读第一部分《采矿基础 #1：基本概述》。

由于这是一份采购订单而非采矿合约，你需要自备设备，例如[HINT_TOOL]。

请注意，为了加快这些材料未来的使用效率，它们必须在交付前进行精炼。这可以在任何精炼厂完成，其位置可在你的星图中找到。

等你你准备好出售我们所需的精炼材料，请将它们存入位于 [DESTINATION] 的货运电梯中。

*接受本合约即表示你原意承担与本合约所列工作相关的所有风险，舒宾星际在对任何在合约期间造成的损害概不负责。

Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.
Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a handheld tractor beam and a ship with space to store [MAX_SCU] cargo containers.
Good luck. I'm counting on you.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.
We got eyes on a [TARGET] that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by [LOCATION], a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.
No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus 12 Council Scrip.
Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.
